_about: Slice settings (docs/slice/slice_tech_plan.md 2.1, 2.4). default_mode: what a run with no --classic/--sandbox/--slice word and no feature tag boots (classic, slice or sandbox). It stays classic until the slice has rooms to boot; VS-35 flips it. new_game: where a slice New Game starts when slice/rooms.json has no start_room (the Level Designer's room ids replace these). retry: Decision 2 (knock-out), recommended A. interact: Decision 3 (talk button), recommended A.
